description_zh: 调用SetBackupPolicy接口设置备份策略
name: SetBackupPolicy

parameters.help_en:
The backup cycle. Valid values:
0: Monday
1: Tuesday
2: Wednesday
3: Thursday
4: Friday
5: Saturday
6: Sunday
parameters.help_zh:
备份周期，取值范围如下：
0：周一
1：周二
2：周三
3：周四
4：周五
5：周六
6：周日
parameters.name: preferred_backup_period

parameters.help_en: The start time of the backup
parameters.name: preferred_backup_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the backup
parameters.name: preferred_backup_end_time

parameters.help_en:
The backup mode. Valid values:
logic: logical backup
phy: physical backup
parameters.help_zh:
备份模式，取值范围如下：
logic：逻辑备份
phy：物理备份
parameters.name: backup_mode

parameters.help_en:
The backup level. Valid values:
db: database level
instance: instance level
parameters.help_zh:
备份级别，取值范围如下：
db：数据库级
instance：实例级
parameters.name: backup_level

parameters.help_en:
The databases to back up. Separate multiple databases with commas (,).
This parameter takes effect only when the backup level is set to database level
parameters.help_zh:
备份涉及到的数据库，多个数据库间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
仅当备份级别为数据库级时该参数才生效
parameters.name: backup_db_names

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable backup logging. Valid values:
1: enabled
0: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
备份日志是否开启，取值范围如下：
1：开启
0：关闭
parameters.name: backup_log

parameters.help_en: The number of days for which data backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730
parameters.help_zh: 数据备份保留天数，取值范围为7~730天
parameters.name: data_backup_retention_period

parameters.help_en: The number of days for which log backups are retained. Valid values: 7 to 730. The value must be less than or equal to the data backup retention period
parameters.help_zh: 日志保留天数，取值范围为7~730天，且必须小于或等于数据备份天数
parameters.name: log_backup_retention_period

Result.description_en: Indicates whether the backup policy is set
Result.description_zh: 备份策略是否设置成功
